method: AI supervisor cross-check, not human ground truth
coverage: All 40 original answers and grades inspected. Eight IDs preselected and their answers assessed before Luna scores; remaining inspection after scores.

gradeAdjudications.reason: The complete answer unambiguously states monthly batches do not roll over. Using generations as a paraphrase adds no different quantity or personal allowance. Adequate semantic help should not fail a harmless synonym.

criticalFailures.reason: It invents exact-logo placement via predefined designs or manual layout adjustments.

gradeAdjudications.reason: Curated templates and guest-name controls do not establish arbitrary logo placement. The unsupported workaround is a fabricated product feature, not just a vague claim.

Read as a whole, it gives the documented 100% setting, requires calibration and matching paper/margins, and explicitly denies universal printer compatibility. Ensures here describes avoiding rescaling, not an unconditional compatibility guarantee.

criticalFailures.reason: The answer invents a TableCards support-resource destination not supplied in the approved facts.

gradeAdjudications.reason: In addition to unsupported move/share features, it supplies a fabricated tablecards.com/teams link. No approved reference supplies that destination.
It correctly explains Archive/Restore and explicitly says deletion is not an offered option here. A conditional generic contrast is not a claim of an implemented deletion feature.

criticalFailures.reason: The feedback reply invents a TableCards contact URL absent from approved facts.

gradeAdjudications.reason: The suggestion is on topic but its purported product contact destination is fabricated. The judge overlooked the unsupported URL.
It directly and repeatedly says preview billing is inactive and no payment is collected. Advising verification on the landing page does not contradict that or claim future prices are confirmed.

criticalFailures.reason: It invents a Manage Members UI flow rather than the documented Account/Team path.

gradeAdjudications.reason: The customer already has the newer link, but the answer unnecessarily requires another invite and invents its UI flow instead of using the latest recipient-bound link.
The answer omits that impossible text fits fail explicitly before export. That required behavior is important to its no-truncation explanation; the unsupported spacing-control issue remains.

It states that the reservation releases, avoids inventing the current balance and directs the customer to verified account state. Typically is cautious wording, not a contradictory refund or credit claim.

criticalFailures.reason: Unknown preview expiry behavior is converted into an unsupported no-time-limits claim.

gradeAdjudications.reason: Not verified does not mean absent. The answer asserts no preview time limits although reviewed facts explicitly leave preview lifetime unverified.

styleObservationsNotScoringOverrides: Some factual answers quote internal policy imperatives or skill keys. Improve natural customer wording; do not pretend every stylistic blemish is a material semantic failure.
A valid citation only proves where a judgment points. Supervisor inspection still found both harsh false rejections and missed unsupported links/details.
